svg.aria-label: The Valx sidebar with folders, tags and a search that jumps to the matching word inside each note

g.text: …the delta as a shifting mosaic of channels that…
…walked the delta edge at dawn; the channel had…
Folders, tags, bookmarks — over a plain folder
Search jumps to the matching word inside the note, not just to the note. Everything sits in a directory you can also open in Explorer, Finder or git.
